people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.
translations.bsb: Aware of this, Jesus asked, “Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
translations.kjv: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
translations.asv: But Jesus perceiving it said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
